newsitem.title: UK: Plane Handling to handle Manchester cargo for Delta.
newsitem.headline: Plane Handling to handle Manchester cargo for Delta.

text.p: Plane Handling has won the contract to handle cargo for Delta Air Lines at Manchester airport from July 1, officials for both companies said.
Until July 1, Aer Lingus Cargo will continue to handle cargo for Delta at Manchester.
Heathrow-based Plane Handling general manager Pat Heslop said it already handled cargo for Delta at Britain's Gatwick airport.

Demand for passenger space on the Atlantic route has persuaded Delta to start three new additonal flights next week. On Monday it starts a new JFK-Manchester daily service with the first Lockheed L-1011-500 Tristar leaving New York on Sunday with possible cargo capacity of 12 to 15 tonnes.

Next week Delta also starts new services between Madrid and JFK and between Stuttgart and Atlanta. A Boeing 767-300ER will be used on both these routes. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017 --www.racs.com
